newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian stocks mixed in livelier OTC trade.
newsitem.headline: Croatian stocks mixed in livelier OTC trade.

text.p: Following is the closing report for Croatia's over-the-counter market in Varazdin and its Osijek outpost for Wednesday, October 16.
* Of 14 traded issues four fell, four rose and six were flat.
* Volume higher at 3,383 shares, turnover 241,666 German marks.
* Biggest gainers, both by 33.33 percent, were a shipping company Tankerska Plovidba and Viktor Lenac repair docks.
- Tankerska rose to 80 marks on volume of 43 shares
- Viktor Lenac, up to 40 marks with 34 units sold
* Textile firm Varteks was the biggest loser, falling 20 percent to 30 marks on volume of 67 shares.
* The most actively traded issue was food processor Podravka, at 78 marks on volume of 871 units.
